meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码提交与改动内容做成一段可分享的讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把 PR 里的改动讲给同事、用户或社区听,却不想自己录屏剪辑。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a code change into a narrated explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain code changes on video but don't want to record and edit.

howto.what: 它把 GitHub PR 变成代码变更讲解视频:读取 diff、提交和文件,规划分帧脚本,生成旁白、字幕和贡献者头像致谢,最后渲染出视频文件。
howto.when: 当你提供的是一个 GitHub PR(PR URL、owner/repo#N,或已检出仓库里的「this PR」)时接管;输入必须是代码变更,不是网站,也不是产品宣传视频。

say.text: 把这个 PR 做成讲解视频:acme/sdk#1842
say.note: 抓取 PR 事实并规划分帧脚本

say.text: 用 acme/sdk#1842 生成变更说明视频
say.note: 会先出分帧方案供你确认

say.text: 把这个修复 PR 做成视频,旁白用男声
say.note: 音频步骤按指定声音生成旁白

howto.what_en: It turns a GitHub pull request into a code-change explainer video: it reads the diff, commits and files, plans a frame-by-frame script, generates narration, captions and contributor-avatar credits, then renders the final video file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you supply a GitHub PR — a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or "this PR" in a checked-out repo. The input must be a code change, not a website or a product promo.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into an explainer video: acme/sdk#1842
say_en.note: Fetches PR facts and plans the frame script

say_en.text: Generate a changelog video from acme/sdk#1842
say_en.note: You approve the frame plan first

say_en.text: Make a video for this fix PR with a male voiceover
say_en.note: Audio step uses the chosen voice
